text: BAM share rose 0.14 percentage points over 25 hours and 0.26 percentage points over 7 days, reaching 32.9% of Solana stake routed through BAM. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-2-tee holds 23.3% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 61 leadership changes this window are best read as whale-driven routing, not broad validator turnover.
